<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs`; edit the source it names instead. -->

Update everything generated from a pack, merging your edits.

## Usage

```sh
cuilo update [OPTIONS] <PACK>
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<PACK>` | Pack name. |

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--from <SOURCE>` | Load the new version from this source. |
| `--on-conflict <ON_CONFLICT>` | What to do where your edits and the new version change the same lines. One of `refuse`, `markers`, `ours`, `theirs`. Default: `refuse`. |
| `--no-migrate` | Do not run the pack's migrations. |
| `--dry-run` | Only show the plan. |
| `-y, --yes` | Apply without asking; with --verify, also run the checks without asking. |
| `--review` | Choose hunk by hunk what to keep, like `git add -p`. |
| `--diff` | Show diffs of changed files. |
| `--force` | Replace existing files that differ. |
| `--verify` | Before applying, run the project's checks on a throwaway copy with the plan applied; apply only when none fails because of the plan. Code from the pack can run there, so the checks start only after you see the plan and agree, or with --yes. |
| `--install` | After applying, add the packages the plan lists with the project's package manager. |
| `--no-install` | Never offer to add the packages the plan lists. |

## Global options

`--root`, `--json` and `--no-input` work here too; see [global options](/reference/cli/#global-options).
